scope: Desktop Godot puzzle integration: eight existing teaching previews, controller lifecycle, native input, storage and visual effects. Screenshots require visual review; not independent puzzle-content or mobile validation.
checks: A failed catalog request shows its resource path and a real reload button recovers without restarting the engine
Native mode button loads eight explicitly labeled teaching previews with sequential unlocks
Real hint/demo buttons expose three hint levels; answer demonstration restores the untouched board without a completion award
Native keyboard completes first puzzle; success waits for the animation and unlocks the next level
All eight existing recommended lines complete through the real controller; black auto-replies animate once, and preview-07 capture produces visible impact particles/rings from three views
Keyboard U undoes a full red/black round; retry during red or black animation cancels stale completion without a second reply
Unproven move is not declared failure; pause/reload preserve the continue gate, bounded defense responds, and unavailable hint stays explicit
Demo interrupted by pause and demo played to the end both restore the original player position, hints and progress
Turn-budget exhaustion and stalemate fail the checkmate goal and remain retryable
Puzzle captures obey the effects checkbox; live reduced-motion preference removes horse leap without changing chess results
Real canvas mouse picking selects the puzzle rook and confirms its destination; keyboard focus and R remain available after failure
Reload during final animation restores the stable winning position and awards completion instead of leaving the next level locked
Corrupt test save is quarantined with a visible warning; future-version save remains protected even after winning; valid completed progress reloads
Switching modes cancels transient visuals, preserves puzzle continuation, and retains the original 32-piece game and soldier thrust demo; production storage untouched
